WITH customer_total_return AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ca_state AS ctr_state,
        SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM catalog_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
)
SELECT
    cust.c_customer_id,
    cust.c_salutation,
    cust.c_first_name,
    cust.c_last_name,
    addr.ca_street_number,
    addr.ca_street_name,
    addr.ca_street_type,
    addr.ca_suite_number,
    addr.ca_city,
    addr.ca_county,
    addr.ca_state,
    addr.ca_zip,
    addr.ca_country,
    addr.ca_gmt_offset,
    addr.ca_location_type,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ctr_state,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS state_avg_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
) AS state_avg
    ON ctr1.ctr_state = state_avg.ctr_state
    AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg.state_avg_total_return
JOIN customer AS cust
    ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address AS addr
    ON addr.ca_address_sk = cust.c_current_addr_sk
WHERE addr.ca_state = 'TN'
ORDER BY
    cust.c_customer_id,
    cust.c_salutation,
    cust.c_first_name,
    cust.c_last_name,
    addr.ca_street_number,
    addr.ca_street_name,
    addr.ca_street_type,
    addr.ca_suite_number,
    addr.ca_city,
    addr.ca_county,
    addr.ca_state,
    addr.ca_zip,
    addr.ca_country,
    addr.ca_gmt_offset,
    addr.ca_location_type,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
